samples.summaryVi: Giờ linh hoạt giúp cân bằng trách nhiệm; cần khoảng giờ chung và biết ai đang có mặt.

paragraphs.label: Mục đích
paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

I am writing to ask for further information about a flexible working discussion. I saw the notice at the community centre and would like to know whether the session would be suitable for someone with limited experience.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chào người biết tên và nêu mục đích.

paragraphs.label: Nhu cầu
paragraphs.text: I am interested in flexible working hours because employees can organise work around practical personal needs. For example, a parent can start earlier on two days so that they can collect a child from school. I would like a practical introduction rather than a session that requires specialist knowledge.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giải thích hoàn cảnh để người nhận tư vấn đúng.

paragraphs.label: Câu hỏi
paragraphs.text: Could you please confirm whether the session is on Saturday at nine in the morning and how long it lasts? I would also like to know the fee and whether materials are included. The notice mentions that participants will compare working schedules and plan shared team hours; should I bring a sample weekly schedule or any other equipment?
paragraphs.noteVi: Câu hỏi gián tiếp về sắp xếp và chuẩn bị.

paragraphs.label: Đăng ký và kết
paragraphs.text:
Finally, could you explain how to register and whether there is a deadline? If places are limited, please let me know when I should apply.

Thank you for taking the time to read my letter. Please let me know if you need any further information. I look forward to your reply.

Yours sincerely,
Minh Nguyen
paragraphs.noteVi: Hỏi bước tiếp, cảm ơn và kết thư trang trọng.
